why: Agent instruction files and file names are judged in strict mode, and strict mode had dropped the two exemptions Persian and Arabic are written with: a zero-width non-joiner inside a Persian word, and a right-to-left mark that keeps a number in place on an Arabic line. A Persian CLAUDE.md, an Arabic AGENTS.md and a Persian file name all failed on their own words. Strict mode now keeps one joiner with a letter of the same joining script on each side, and one bidi mark on a line that has right-to-left script, and nothing else. The pass side tracks exactly those three. The fail side tracks the same CLAUDE.md with a zero-width space in place of the joiner and the same AGENTS.md with a right-to-left override in place of the mark. Whoever drops the strict exemptions turns the pass side red; whoever applies the prose exemptions to agent files turns the fail side green. Content and the name are base64 because rebar reads its own caso.json raw.
